description:
Goal: make build_form always yield MacroCall for scope-definition heads and remove the Source/CompilerFragment branch (quoted_surface.rs:354-366). Delete ScopeSurfaceMode and the mode parameter on read_scope_surface_with_mode, read_do_body_surface_with_mode, flush_function_groups, build_form. Collapse read_scope_surface and read_compiler_fragment_surface to one user-surface reader. discover_modules keeps only the MacroCall arm for user code; the typed arms are served by the extractor via the bootstrap/define-tier paths from fz-s00.2.

Why: one read; def-head structure comes from the define pipeline. ScopeSurfaceMode was the symptom of fusing phase (pre vs post expansion) with origin (bootstrap vs user).

Signal: ScopeSurfaceMode and read_compiler_fragment_surface as a source def-head reader are gone; a def-head is read once as a MacroCall; full lib green, zero warnings; behavior invariant. Depends on fz-s00.2.
title: Delete ScopeSurfaceMode; user reader yields MacroCall for def-heads
